body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> US Telematics introduced 'Vivee(Voice Interactive Voice Enhanced Email)' solution during CES 2008 Unveiled NY Press Preview. The Vivee can read email or SMS text messages via activated avatar characters on mobile phones. It could be useful for drivers particularly since it enables them to keep their hands on the wheels. The company is currently teaming up with Palm for this solution.
